command:
cd /home/emp/Documents/VAC/vac-web && set -e \
  && echo '=== R2: release.* events present in catalog ===' \
  && grep -c 'release\.' config/control-plane/event-catalog.yaml \
  && echo '=== R2: classification field count (expect 4) ===' \
  && grep -c '^    classification:' config/control-plane/event-catalog.yaml \
  && echo '=== R3: pr-checklist --help ===' \
  && node scripts/vac-pr-checklist.mjs --help | head -3 \
  && echo '=== R3: pr-checklist smoke run vs HEAD~1 ===' \
  && node scripts/vac-pr-checklist.mjs --base HEAD~1 2>&1 | head -25 \
  && echo '=== R3: package.json pr:checklist registered ===' \
  && node -e 'const p=require("./package.json");if(!p.scripts["pr:checklist"])throw new Error("missing");console.log(p.scripts["pr:checklist"])' \
  && echo '=== R4: adoption stance section present ===' \
  && grep -c 'Adoption stance per missing maturity pattern' docs/external-best-practice-benchmark.md \
  && echo '=== R4: 8 patterns referenced ===' \
  && for pat in 'spec.*status' 'Reconciliation' 'Conditions' 'Admission' 'Dry-run' 'Version conversion' 'Golden examples' 'Provenance'; do count=$(grep -ciE "$pat" docs/external-best-practice-benchmark.md); echo "  $pat: $count"; done \
  && echo '=== R5: trust model + ADR present ===' \
  && wc -l docs/extension-trust-model.md docs/adr/0003-extension-trust-model.md \
  && echo '=== R5: cross-link in extension-boundaries ===' \
  && grep -c 'extension-trust-model.md' docs/extension-boundaries.md \
  && echo '=== R5: slice 47 outputs extended ===' \
  && grep -c 'extension-trust-model\|0003-extension-trust' docs/plans/wiring/47-extension-plugin-boundaries.md \
  && echo '=== Final git diff --stat ===' \
  && git diff --stat | tail -25 \
  && echo '=== ALL R2-R5 GATES OK ==='
